text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency breach detected for inference-service-usw2 (model: meta-xl). p99=1.2s over 5m window. Page fired to oncall. Links: https://telemetry.redwood/s/abc123 ; runbook: /runbooks/latency-fallback

alex: On it. ACKing.

alex: quick check — any deploys in last 30m?

maria: no deploys. saw a small autoscale event ~10m ago then more tails.

cheng: metrics: CPU on batcher sidecars spiking, KV cache hit rate down 18%. Could be hotkey or cache eviction.

alex: grabbing slowlogs and hotkey map. If hotkey, we can route heavy clients to fallback model temporarily.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident  INC-9342 opened and targeted to team:eng-oncall, severity:high.

alex: temp mitigation plan: 1) Add route rule to favor model-quantized for non-sensitive tenants. 2) Increase pool size for model-serving-usw2 by +2 GPUs (on Dedicated) 3) Force KV warmup for top 5 keys. 4) Disable large-batch window for 10m.

maria: I can flip the route rule. doing that now: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/route -d '{"rule":"prefer:model-quantized","match":"!enterprise"}'`

cheng: scaling up pool: `kubectl scale deployment/model-serving --replicas=6 -n us-west-2` (issuing)

alex: good. also adding a temporary throttle on big requests: `config set max_tokens 1024` on edge-proxy.

maria: route rule live. seeing gradual drop in p95, p99 still high.

alex: KV warmup queued: `warmup --keys=hotkeys_top5 --region=usw2`

cheng: pool scaled, pods coming up. sidecar CPU still elevated on 1 pod; evicted KV shard on that node earlier. I'm isolating that node from traffic.

oncall-next: i'm next oncall in 18m — will take over if this continues.

alex: short customer-impact note: some PLG tenants may see high tail latency for inference requests; enterprise customers on Dedicated unaffected. No data loss, only latency.

maria: p99 trending down from 1.2s -> 880ms after route + scale. continue to monitor for 15m.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Action Checkpoint: route applied, pool scaled, KV warmup queued, throttle applied.

cheng: follow-up: investigating root cause — initial hypothesis: KV evictions due to recent autoscaler shuffle + one noisy client with heavy long-context tail. I'll open a brief postmortem if we confirm.

alex: handing to oncall-next for rotation at 18m. Notes posted in pagerduty and runbook updated with steps taken.

oncall-next: acked, I'll monitor for the handoff window. keep me posted if p99 climbs back above 1s.

maria: adding alert suppression for noisy duplicate pages for 10m while we're stabilizing.

alex: closing action items: ensure cache eviction thresholds adjusted, add a health check for batcher-sidecar CPU > 85%, run a tenant traffic replay to confirm warmup.

incident-bot: :information_source: Incident update: p99=760ms, p95=220ms. Paging suppressed.

alex: thanks team — reopening if it regresses. :thumbsup:
